x.ab.title: About this prototype
x.ab.what: A working exhibit for our {f:meta.event} entry, "Higher Ground". It shows how the proposed organisation would behave on the showroom floor: honest comparison, channel neutrality, after-sales promises, a consented hand-off to a person, and data that feeds management. It is not an official Maruti Suzuki product.
x.ab.honest: No number appears without a source. Tap any figure to see where it came from and when it was checked. Where we could not confirm a figure, the screen shows a Verify tag and no number. Programme features are proposals and are labelled as such everywhere.
x.ab.data: {total} facts in the library. {verified} checked against a published source, {team} from our team's research, {gaps} flagged for verification. Prices are ex-showroom, New Delhi, as published in {f:meta.period}.
x.ab.engine: Candidates are Maruti Suzuki SUV variants from both channels, filtered by the buyer's fuel and budget. They are scored only on the one or two priorities the buyer chose: {f:rule.weight.first} on the first and {f:rule.weight.second} on the second. Each priority is normalised across the candidates. Ties go to the launch rule, then to the lower price.
x.ab.engine.c1: Running cost: fuel per thousand km at the buyer's fuel price.
x.ab.engine.c2: Safety: half on crash-test stars, a quarter on airbags, a quarter on driver-assistance level. An untested car earns nothing for a rating it does not have.
x.ab.engine.c3: Resale and peace of mind: the proposed Promise, plus resale evidence where we have it. Today that is the Grand Vitara only.
x.ab.engine.c4: Design and features: a declared proxy. Feature lists are not yet in the checked library, so variants rank by position in their model's price walk. The Match screen says so.
x.ab.engine.c5: Performance: power. Capability: all-wheel drive plus ground clearance.
x.ab.engine.rival: A rival is never the primary recommendation. When a rival's closest variant beats our pick on the buyer's first priority, the Match screen says so in plain words.
x.ab.variants: Up to six per model: entry petrol, mainstream automatic, CNG where sold, all-wheel drive where sold, and the base and top strong hybrid or top trim. Diesel rivals are included because leaving them out would hide a real advantage.
x.ab.prior: Arena launched in {f:prior.arena.year} with interactive product touchscreens, and NEXA ran an AR showroom from {f:prior.nexa.year}. What is new here: the comparison is conversational and fact-checked; the session hands off to the buyer's phone and to a named person; the kiosk extends to public places; and it feeds a management scorecard.
x.ab.econ.1: Hardware: {f:econ.hardware} per outlet, paid by the dealer.
x.ab.econ.2: About {f:econ.sessions} sessions per kiosk per month, at about {f:econ.ai} per session for the answer engine.
x.ab.econ.3: Running cost: about {f:econ.run} per kiosk per year. One-time platform build: {f:econ.build}.
x.ab.econ.4: At full roll-out, including the {f:prog.content.cost} content team: {calc} a year. The workbook figure is {f:econ.total}.
x.ab.roll.1: Pilot, months {f:roll.pilot.months}: {f:roll.pilot.cities} cities, {f:roll.pilot.outlets} outlets, NEXA and Arena pairs against control outlets.
x.ab.roll.4: Public kiosk pods, months {f:roll.pods.months}: {f:roll.pods} pods in malls, campuses and airports, scaled only if bookings per pod beat the digital cost per booking.
x.ab.price.h: Why there is no on-road price
x.ab.price: In {f:cci.date} the CCI penalised Maruti Suzuki {f:cci.penalty} for resale price maintenance. Dealers set prices. The kiosk therefore shows ex-showroom prices only, and price is left out of the dealer scorecard.
x.ab.privacy: The consent flow follows the {f:law.dpdp}: notice before consent, a specific purpose, a box that starts unticked, easy withdrawal, a stated retention period of {f:prog.retention.days}, and a QR path that carries no personal data. In this prototype nothing personal leaves your browser, and no message is sent.
x.ab.limits.1: The council dashboard runs on simulated data from a fixed seed. It shows the shape of the reporting, not a result.
x.ab.limits.2: Surfaces sync inside one browser. A booking made on a real phone does not reach the tablet, because there is no server.
x.ab.limits.3: Hindi copy was written by the build, not by a native reviewer. Every string is listed for review.
x.ab.limits.4: The on-screen keyboard is Latin only. In Hindi mode buyers tap suggested questions or type in English letters.
x.ab.limits.5: Car images are placeholders naming the shot needed. No press photography is used.
x.ab.limits.6: The electric is left out of running-cost comparisons until a consumption figure is sourced.
